speaker: alice
text: Right, environment first, and it's reef season baby. Marine scientists reckon the Great Barrier Reef is just about ready for its annual coral spawning, that wild once a year event where the reef basically throws a confetti party underwater.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah it's one of those things that still blows my mind, millions of coral polyps releasing eggs and sperm into the water on the same night, all triggered by the moon and the water temp. Nature's timing is better than my alarm clock.

speaker: alice
text: Citizen science crews up and down the coast are gearing up to help monitor it too, which is such a lovely reminder that everyday Queenslanders get to play a part in looking after the reef. And speaking of sunny things, solar's having a moment as well.
